name: stempel-kit
description: Stempel Kit: spec-driven workflow, guard hooks, CI gates and subagents for Claude Code, with extensions for evidence packs, autopilot, routing, run records, risk ranks and onboarding, plus repo-check, a read-only delivery assessment

plugins.name: stempel-kit
plugins.description: The core: spec-driven workflow, guard and check hooks, three subagents and approval gates for Claude Code. Extensions add the evidence pack, autopilot, routing, run records, risk ranks and onboarding

plugins.name: repo-check
plugins.description: Find where your delivery is jammed right now: a 10-question interview or a strictly read-only scan of the repository. Sends nothing.

plugins.name: stempel-kit-evidence
plugins.description: Extension: /verify-feature and the evidence pack with hard gates, data runs, the edge-case matrix and screenshots. Needs stempel-kit-onboard

plugins.name: stempel-kit-routing
plugins.description: Extension: model routing per dispatched agent, the token usage record and a token budget per branch

plugins.name: stempel-kit-autopilot
plugins.description: Extension: unattended builds with one headless session per planned group, stacked pull requests per group, the build status and steering. Needs stempel-kit-routing

plugins.name: stempel-kit-improve
plugins.description: Extension: run records per branch, lead time for changes and /improve-kit, which proposes kit changes from them

plugins.name: stempel-kit-onboard
plugins.description: Extension: /onboard for existing repositories and a baseline so legacy failures never block a pull request
